title: Nyang Hana Meugoyang Saboh
intro: Lam catatan seujarah nubuat, bacut mantong nyang ka geuhadapi kerugian dan keusosahan fisik nyang mendalam lagee nyan deungon iman nyang hana meugoyang. Kisah tokoh nyoe nakeuh saboh peulajaran abadi lam kesabaran dan peucaya keu hikmah ilahi. Soe jiwa nyoe?
clues: Lon geupiléh lé Allah untôk peusampoë saboh peusan, tapi ujian njang paléng rajek ulôn teuka kon rot peunolakan, tapi rot musibah pribadi.
Keukayaan ulôn, beulatang peulara dan aneuëk-aneuëk lôn jicok nibak ulôn sidroe deumi nyang laén.
Tuboh ulôn ka meu-ulang-ulang, dan ulôn tinggai sidroe kecuali dukungan pasangan ulôn.
Lon meulakèe ubak Tuhan lon, lon akui deurita lon dan lon mita rahmat Gobnyan.
Lon geubri peurintah keu lon poh tanoh ngon gaki lon, dan mata ie nyang segar jiteubiet.
Allah neupeupuléh keuséhatan ulôn dan neubri keu ulôn keuluarga barô dan bahkan hareuta njang leubèh rajek nibak njang ka ulôn na.

verse: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment." (38:41)
